title: RETRIBUTION PALADIN

source.author: Ruse_Cruize
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Paladin Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: Seal, Holy Strike, Judgement and Consecration: sustained damage, self healing and group buffs.

build.early: Level 20 cap players: take Seal of Command before Pursuit of Justice. Vengeance is the long-term payoff but its full power is not visible in this beta.

why.Benediction: Cheaper instant spells: Judgement, Seals, Consecration, Exorcism, Holy Strike, Hammer of Justice.
why.Pursuit of Justice: 15% movement and mounted speed at all times.
why.Seal of Command: Big damage with Hammer of Justice; better on slow weapons.
why.Sacred Arbiter: Damage bonus and easier Judgement uptime.
why.Vindication: Attack Power and a small enemy debuff.
why.Vengeance: Stacking damage buff once you have the crit to keep it up.

core.t: Instant weapon strike with Holy damage; use on cooldown.
Weapon slower than 3.8s: Command. Faster: Righteousness.
Keep it down against several enemies.
Burst self-heal between pulls or off-healing.

items.t: keep a Seal up at all times (Righteousness on fast weapons)

notes: Mana only regenerates after 5 seconds without spending any, so cast several spells back to back and let it trickle in.
Use your utility: Blessing of Freedom, Sacrifice and Protection, Purify and Hammer of Justice for yourself and your party.
Group buffs matter: Blessing of Kings, Might and Wisdom plus Devotion and Retribution Aura make the whole party stronger.

stats.t: More damage on every hit. Top for both races.
Crit chance (synergy with Vengeance) and defense. Second for Undead, third for Human.
Second for Human, who lack Undead's natural regen and healing.
Preferred over Stamina: decent healing efficiency, more mana per point, some spell crit.
Keep at least a little for survivability.

gear: When two weapons have similar DPS, take the slower one: Holy Strike and Seal of Command both scale with weapon damage.
Weapon speed decides your Seal: slower than 3.8 seconds per swing means Seal of Command, faster means Seal of Righteousness.
Human order: Strength, Spirit, Agility, Intellect, Stamina. Undead order: Strength, Agility, Intellect, Stamina, Spirit.
dungeon_tips: Consecration is your area damage: great for clearing groups of enemies while questing.
Off-heal with Flash of Light for bursts and Holy Light for sustained healing.
You bring Blessings and Auras that make the whole party stronger.

alliance.note: Will to Survive breaks stuns, Perception counters stealth, The Human Spirit adds regen, Sword Specialization +2% crit with swords.

horde.note: Strongest for leveling: Cannibalize resets quickly (and restores mana) and Touch of the Grave steals health on hit.

races.pick: Undead leads for leveling; Human may be better for Holy at endgame.
